_doc: Cooum river (waterway 2) pipeline config. Extent decision on record 19 Aug 2026: the FULL river as OSM maps it - one way (202505379) in relation 11901885, 62.9 km from the origin junction near Satharai (lon 79.843) to the Bay of Bengal mouth (lon 80.291). WRD's IAMWARM DPR gives the river 65 km from that origin ('72 km' in early notes is WRD's distance from the city to Kesavaram anicut, not river length; 32 km is the ICRERP restoration reach, Paruthipattu to the mouth). Chainage 0 at the upstream origin, increasing to the mouth.

feature.name: Cooum River (Satharai origin - Chennai mouth)

sites._doc: Anchors are centerline points at chainages converted from WRD mouth-based chainages (hyd-headworks.csv): Aranvoyal 45.33 km, Korattur 40.95 km, Paruthipattu ~27.3 km, Chetpet tidal head ~9.4 km from the mouth; our chainage total is 62.8 km. Verify anicut positions against the rendered chips at curation.
